problem: Chats and agents could build and verify a candidate yet still leave routine protected merge/deploy as human follow-up.
root_cause: Production promotion was permitted in the autonomy contract but was not an explicit ownership obligation of the current authorized execution node.
fix: Make self-promotion mandatory after terminal-green required gates within existing authority.
Keep protected merge/deploy and production readback in the same execution tail.
Treat interruption as recoverable same-lineage work rather than a handoff to the user.
Allow only explicit hard authorization boundaries to stop autonomous production execution.
